Hey! We're uni students interested in tech, coding, and space. We're excited to take on this challenge, learn new things, and build something cool together!

We're looking for teammates who are into coding, design, science, or just have creative ideas. No need to be an expert, just bring good vibes and teamwork! 🚀
summary:
Mars Explorer is an interactive 3D platform that allows users to explore the surface of Mars. It combines NASA surface imagery and elevation data to display the planet's mountains, valleys, craters, and other geological features.
   Users can explore Mars, select locations, analyze terrain, and plan missions using the Mission Planner. The platform also includes an AI assistant that provides scientific information about selected locations.
   Our project addresses the challenge by making Martian geography and scientific data easier to explore and understand through an interactive experience.
   Mars Explorer is important because it makes planetary exploration more accessible, supports scientific learning, and helps users better understand the Martian environment.
details:
Project Development and Impact

Mars Explorer was developed as a web-based platform that turns scientific Mars data into an interactive exploration experience. Users can move from a global view of Mars to detailed surface exploration, inspect geographical locations, study elevation changes, and plan possible exploration routes.

One of our main goals was to make planetary data easier to understand. Instead of presenting users with complicated scientific maps, we created a visual environment where they can interact directly with the terrain. The AI assistant adds another layer by helping users understand geological features and scientific information about selected locations.

We used JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, and Vite. Our project incorporates Viking Orbiter imagery and MOLA/HRSC elevation data. We also used AI-assisted development tools during implementation.

What makes Mars Explorer creative is the combination of a 3D globe, first-person surface exploration, terrain analysis, mission planning, and AI assistance in one platform.

During development, we considered data accuracy, visual quality, performance, accessibility, and ease of navigation. We wanted the experience to be both scientifically informative and enjoyable to use.

Our intended impact is to make Mars exploration more accessible to students, educators, and anyone interested in planetary science.
